sentence: And the market's reward for AI innovation splits along firm traits: return on assets improves a little, more for firms heavy on R&D, while firm value rises only where sustainability metrics are good, with Democratic administrations amplifying the reward
passage: [Singh et al. (2026), abstract] "The study finds mixed evidence of a small positive impact of AI innovation on firms' return on assets, with the effect stronger for more R&D-intensive firms." / "The findings demonstrate that AI innovation increases firm value for companies that perform well on sustainability-related metrics. This effect is stronger under Democratic administrations than under Republican governments"

gemini.note: The sentence drops the passage's caveat of 'mixed evidence' regarding return on assets and adds the restrictive word 'only', making the claim about firm value more exclusive than the passage supports.
